problem.text: All of the triangles in the diagram below are similar to isosceles triangle $ABC$, in which $AB = AC$. Each of the $7$ smallest triangles has area $1$, and $\triangle ABC$ has area $40$. What is the area of trapezoid $DBCE$?

steps.title: Where to start: similar triangles scale area by the square
steps.body: The trapezoid $DBCE$ is triangle $ABC$ with triangle $ADE$ removed from the top. We know the area of $ABC$, so we need the area of $ADE$. All the triangles are similar, and when a shape is scaled by a factor $k$, its area is multiplied by $k^2$.

your_turn.prompt: A triangle similar to a smallest triangle has sides $3$ times as long. What is its area?

steps.title: Measure $DE$ in small triangles
steps.body: Look at the strip of $7$ small triangles just above $DE$. The $4$ upward-pointing ones sit side by side with their bases along $DE$, and together their bases fill all of $DE$. So $DE$ is $4$ times the base of a smallest triangle, and triangle $ADE$ is a smallest triangle scaled by $4$.

your_turn.prompt: What is the area of triangle $ADE$?

steps.title: Check with the top triangle
steps.body: Triangle $ADE$ is made of the triangle with apex $A$ plus the $7$ small triangles. The top triangle's base is the upper edge of the strip, which holds the bases of the $3$ downward-pointing triangles, so it is $3$ small bases wide. Careful: the trapezoid is everything below $DE$, so you must remove all of triangle $ADE$, not only the $7$ small triangles.

your_turn.prompt: Find the area of the top triangle and add the $7$ small triangles. Does it match?
your_turn.answer: The top triangle has area $3^2 = 9$, and $9 + 7 = 16$, which matches the area of $ADE$.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body:
The trapezoid is what is left of triangle $ABC$ after removing triangle $ADE$.
$$[DBCE] = 40 - 16 = 24$$
The answer is **(E)** $24$.

wrong_choices.A: $16$ is the area of triangle $ADE$, the part above $DE$. The trapezoid is the part below $DE$, so subtract it from $40$.

verification.verifier_notes: Passed adversarial verifier on first review.
